summary: Small, well-documented module; write-once policy binding, RAII timer, and Drop-side logging are all clean (no locks, no panics in production paths). Two Low-severity visibility observations only; the historically flagged issues (3x-duplicated 2.0 constant, duplicate threshold math, bench-only StageTimer) are already fixed or explicitly settled by prior audits and are not re-reported.

findings.title: init_metrics_runtime is pub but has only crate-internal callers
findings.description: src/metrics/mod.rs lives under `pub mod metrics` (src/lib.rs:96), so `pub fn init_metrics_runtime` is part of the crate's external API. Its only callers are inside the crate (src/config/load.rs:260 and src/config/load.rs:369, both in Config::load). Letting external crates install the process-wide metrics runtime is almost certainly not an intended contract; nothing downstream in this workspace uses it. NOTE: reducing visibility to pub(crate) is a breaking API change for any external consumer of alephcore, so only do it if a semver-major window is acceptable.

findings.title: pub fn on a module-private struct is unnameable surface
findings.description: `struct MetricsRuntime` (src/metrics/mod.rs:41) is private to the module, so the `pub` on `impl MetricsRuntime { pub fn warning_threshold_ms(...) }` grants nothing — the method is unnameable outside src/metrics/ anyway. It is read only by StageTimer::drop in the same file. The redundant `pub` (and `#[must_use]`, whose warning would also never fire externally) is dead surface area that suggests wider availability than exists. Non-breaking to tighten since the item is already unnameable externally.

notes_on_settled_prior_findings: StageTimer has zero production callers in src/ (only benches/performance_benchmarks.rs and the lib.rs:275 re-export): explicitly accepted by commit 5b697ed06 (R10 carve-out keeping bench/public API). Re-reporting would re-litigate a settled decision.

The previously reported 2.0 constant triplication and MetricsPolicy::warning_threshold_ms duplicate math are fixed: DEFAULT_WARNING_MULTIPLIER is now defined once at src/config/types/policies/metrics.rs:50 and re-exported pub(crate) into src/metrics/mod.rs:33, and the policy-side duplicate method no longer exists.
Drop-side double-logging is intentional: the slow-warning branch returns early so a slow stage logs warn! only once and is not also echoed at debug level.
